scientific_integrity: Explicit proof plus exhaustive independently implemented direct multiplication checks through four points; finite checks do not certify the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the complete rank-one Boolean-relation semigroup, not arbitrary binary relations; the j=0 specialization and general clique-number theory are prior work. Earlier general Rees zero-matrix enumeration may imply it; independent verification has not been performed.
title: Full clique and maximal-clique spectra of rank-one Boolean relation semigroups
